text: Two named methods give chlorobenzene. The Sandmeyer reaction uses copper one chloride in hydrochloric acid. The Gattermann reaction uses copper powder with hydrochloric acid. Iodobenzene needs no catalyst: just warm the diazonium salt with potassium iodide. And fluorobenzene comes from the Balz Schiemann reaction, heating the dry fluoroborate salt.
